DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The clinical picture of a 1-month-old infant with a history of maternal non-immunity to rubella, prematurity, and signs suggestive of cardiac involvement (tachycardia) and anemia is highly consistent with Congenital Rubella Syndrome.
